hui.algorithm: EFIM (src/huim/efim.py, exact; verified against brute force)

models.rel: strength relative to the strongest AP (40 dB window)

candidates.floor_rule: floor whose 20 best cells have the highest mean smoothed HUI score (kf=20)
candidates.score: S = P(gamma=2,tau=20) * V^3, Gaussian smoothing sigma=3 m within the floor

features.transform: each feature + (x - max over candidates), min-max within the query, rank; then signed log; z-score

scorer.loss: mean(0.766126 * ||sum_i w_i c_i - x_true||), w = softmax(s)
scorer.ensemble: one member per training fold; member i early-stops on fold i and is fitted on the others; scores averaged, then softmax
